label: Set obligation level
summary: Changes the obligation level of the character's contract with their overlord.
details: The level can be given as a number (an index), the name of a level such as `feudal_obligation_low`, or a saved scope. The documented usage lines are written with `vassal_contract_set_obligation_level`, so check which spelling the game accepts. No vanilla use is given.

fields.name: type
fields.text: Which obligation type of the contract is changed.
fields.values: the name of an obligation type

fields.name: level
fields.text: The new level for that obligation.
fields.values: a number (index), a level name like feudal_obligation_low, or a scope such as scope:obligation

label: Pan camera to province
summary: Moves the camera to the given province.
details: Vanilla uses it with a province saved in a scope and with a location link.

label: Pan camera to title
summary: Moves the camera to the given title.
details: Vanilla gives it a title directly (`title:k_ireland`), a title link such as `capital_barony`, or a saved scope.

label: Pause the journey
summary: Pauses a travel plan until it is resumed explicitly.
details: Any resume date set by an earlier pause is removed. Written as `yes` (vanilla always uses `yes`); the game's documentation also lists `no`. Works on a travel plan.

label: Pause the journey (multiplayer)
summary: Pauses a travel plan until it is resumed, but only in a multiplayer game.
details: Any resume date set by an earlier pause is removed. Works on a travel plan. Vanilla uses it once, with `yes`.

label: Pay gold into a treasury
summary: Makes the character pay gold, which the target character receives as treasury.
details: The character the effect runs on pays; the target receives. No vanilla use is given, so the exact amount handling is not shown.

fields.name: target
fields.text: The character who receives the payment.

fields.name: value
fields.text: How much is paid.
fields.values: a number or a script value

label: Pay herd
summary: Makes the character pay herd to the target character.
details: The character the effect runs on pays; the target receives. Vanilla gives the amount as a value from the domicile, such as `domicile.minor_herd_value`.

fields.name: target
fields.text: The character who receives the herd.
fields.values: a character, such as root or a saved scope

fields.name: value
fields.text: How much herd is paid.
fields.values: a number or a script value

label: Pay gold (long-term budget)
summary: Makes the character pay gold to the target, taking it from their 'long term' AI budget first and then from the rest.
details: The character the effect runs on pays; the target receives. 'Long term' is one of the categories of the AI budget.

fields.name: target
fields.text: The character who receives the gold.

fields.name: gold
fields.text: How much gold is paid.
fields.values: a number or a script value, for example 25

label: Pay income (long-term budget)
summary: Makes the character immediately pay the target an amount of gold equal to their income over a stated time, taking it from the 'long term' AI budget first and then from the rest.
details: The time is given in days, months or years. The character the effect runs on pays; the target receives. No vanilla use is given.

fields.name: target
fields.text: The character who receives the gold.

fields.name: days / months / years
fields.text: For how much time the income is paid out.

label: Plan great project
summary: Starts funding a Great Project of the chosen type in the province.
details: The founder pays the initial cost and can fund contributions before other rulers. Works on a province. Vanilla can also save the new project as a scope with `save_scope_as`.

fields.name: founder
fields.text: The character who pays the initial cost and gets first pick at contributing.
fields.values: a character, such as root or a saved scope

fields.name: great_project_type
fields.text: Which kind of Great Project is planned.
fields.values: a great project type key, for example mandala_capital_01

fields.name: save_scope_as
fields.text: Saves the new project under this name so later script can refer to it.

label: Play music cue
summary: Plays the named music cue.
details: Vanilla uses it very often, with cues named after the mood, such as `mx_cue_prison`, `mx_cue_murder` or `mx_cue_death`. Works on a character.

label: Play sound effect
summary: Plays the named sound effect.
details: Vanilla writes the sound as an audio event path starting with `event:/`, for example the contract success sound. Works on a character.

label: Pledged attacker
summary: Makes the target character join a great holy war as an attacker.
details: The target must have the same faith as the one who declared the holy war. Works on a great holy war. Vanilla gives the character as root or a saved scope.

label: Pledged defender
summary: Makes the target character join a great holy war as a defender.
details: The target must have the same faith as the target of the holy war. Works on a great holy war. Vanilla gives the character as root or root's leader.

label: Populate task contracts
summary: Fills the area around a location with task contracts, up to the given amount.
details: The `group` list names the contract groups to use. Works on a character. Vanilla gives the location as a province (a saved scope or a character's location) and the groups as named contract groups.

fields.name: location
fields.text: The province the area is centred on.

fields.name: amount
fields.text: How many contracts to spawn at most.
fields.values: a number or a script value

fields.name: group
fields.text: Which contract groups may be used.
fields.values: a list of contract group keys in braces

label: Move to the next phase after…
summary: Moves the activity on to its next phase after the given time.
details: The time can be written in days, weeks or months. Vanilla mostly uses `days = 1`. Works on an activity.

fields.name: days / weeks / months
fields.text: How long to wait before the phase changes.

label: Random chance
summary: Runs the effects inside it only with the given percentage chance.
details: The chance can be changed by an optional modifier list (the same kind of list used for mean time to happen). Vanilla uses chances such as 50, 25 and 75, and puts everything from events and toasts to trait changes inside.

fields.name: chance
fields.text: The chance, as a percentage, that the effects run.
fields.values: a number or a script value

fields.name: modifier
fields.text: Optional rules that raise or lower the chance.

label: Raze county
summary: Changes the holding of the county's capital province to the given type.
details: With `purge_secondary_holdings = yes`, all other holdings in the county are destroyed too, except those whose type is listed as excluded. Works on a county title. Vanilla uses it once, turning the capital into a nomad holding and purging the rest.

fields.name: holding_type
fields.text: The holding type the capital province gets.
fields.values: a holding type, for example nomad_holding

fields.name: purge_secondary_holdings
fields.text: Whether all other holdings in the county are destroyed.

fields.name: excluded_holding_type
fields.text: A holding type that is spared by the purge. Can be repeated.
fields.values: a holding type, for example temple_holding

label: Rebuild great building
summary: Rebuilds the Great Building in the province, so it is no longer ruined.
details: Works on a province. Vanilla uses it twice, written as `yes`.

label: Recalculate cultural heads
summary: Forces the game to work out the cultural heads again for the given way of choosing them.
details: The game's documentation lists `domain` and `herd` as the types. Vanilla uses it once, with `herd`.

label: Recalculate participant group
summary: Forces the game to work out again which participation group the character belongs to in a situation.
details: Works on a character; the situation is the value. Vanilla gives it situations such as `situation:dynastic_cycle` and `situation:the_christian_church`.

label: Recalculate election vote
summary: Makes the elector decide their vote again in every succession election they vote in, and applies it at once.
details: Without this, the vote would only change at their next AI update. It does nothing for a player character, whose vote is their own to cast. Works on a character. Written as `yes`. No vanilla use is given.

label: Record situation event
summary: Adds a special entry to the situation's history, dated the day the effect runs.
details: It only applies to situations that keep a full history (`keep_full_history = yes`). The `key` selects the localization text of the entry, and the character and the variables can be used in that text. Variables can only hold objects (characters, titles), not plain values. Works on a situation.

fields.name: key
fields.text: Names the entry and its localization text.

fields.name: actor
fields.text: A character the entry is about.

fields.name: phase
fields.text: The situation phase the entry belongs to.

fields.name: variables
fields.text: Objects the entry's text can refer to.
fields.values: a block of name = object pairs
